verdict.rationale: Docs show performance-oriented routing features (latency/uptime-based default provider selection, per-provider timeouts for fast failover, sort by performance metric, and 'caching: auto') that imply an emphasis on low overhead, but there is no explicit benchmark or first-party claim quantifying the gateway's own added latency, nor independent hands-on latency testing. Missing for 10: direct latency-overhead benchmarks, third-party performance comparisons, and explicit claims about the gateway's own processing time versus direct provider calls.
